Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.numerics

Class CoupledPressureMomentumSolver

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.numerics.CoupledPressureMomentumSolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class CoupledPressureMomentumSolver extends Object implements Serializable
Coupled pressure-momentum correction for the transient two-fluid finite-volume state.

The explicit transport step supplies a provisional conservative state. This class solves a compressible pressure equation formed from the fixed-cell-volume residual and the pressure correction to the total volumetric flux. The same face pressure correction is then applied to every phase mass flux and momentum, so phase masses remain globally conservative while pressure and velocity are advanced in the same accepted step.

The correction is intentionally independent of closure correlations. Phase compressibility is supplied through the local phase sound speeds, and the pressure equation uses the mobility A * sum(alpha_k / rho_k). A fixed outlet pressure is represented by a Dirichlet pressure correction; the inlet and non-fixed outlet use zero correction gradient.

      Correct a provisional conservative state with a coupled pressure and phase-momentum solve.
      Parameters:
      provisionalState - conservative variables in kg/m and kg/s
      timeStep - accepted substep in s
      pressure - cell pressure in Pa
      areas - cell cross-sectional area in m2
      lengths - cell axial length in m
      gasDensity - gas density in kg/m3
      oilDensity - oil density in kg/m3
      waterDensity - water density in kg/m3
      gasSoundSpeed - gas sound speed in m/s
      oilSoundSpeed - oil sound speed in m/s
      waterSoundSpeed - water sound speed in m/s
      outletPressure - fixed outlet pressure in Pa
      outletPressureFixed - true for a Dirichlet outlet pressure
      Returns:
      corrected state, pressure, density, and convergence diagnostics
